fields.body_md:
## At a glance

Newcastle University teaches its master's courses on its Newcastle Campus. A one-year master's here costs **£32,800 to £34,400** in tuition, depending on the course. That is lower than most of the 12 UK universities we checked for Computer Science and Data Science.

| | MSc Computer Science | MSc Data Science | MBA |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tuition for overseas students (2027-28) | **£33,400** | **£32,800** | **£34,400** |
| Length | 12 months full-time | 12 months full-time | 12 months full-time |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** overall, **5.5** in each skill | **6.5** overall, **5.5** in each skill | **6.5** overall, **6.0** in each skill |

## What it costs in the first year

Tuition is charged for the one-year course. For the UK student visa you must also show living money: **£1,171 a month** outside London, for up to **9 months**, which comes to **£10,539**. You pay the **£558** visa fee and the **£776** health surcharge on top.

For MSc Computer Science that adds up to **£33,400 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 = £45,273**. This is an example, not a budget. Read how the visa rules work in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide), and compare other universities in the [UK cost guide](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

The MSc Computer Science page says you may be eligible for a scholarship worth **25% off the international fee**. Check the course page for who qualifies and how to apply.

## Getting in

What Newcastle asks for depends on the course:

- **MSc Computer Science:** a 2:2 honours degree or equivalent, in any subject except those related to computer science. This course is for students changing direction.
- **MSc Data Science:** a 2:2 honours degree or international equivalent.
- **MBA:** a 2:1 honours degree or international equivalent, and at least three years of work experience.

For Indian degrees, Newcastle's grade table says a UK 2:1 equals **60% or a CGPA of 6.0 out of 10**. A 2:2 equals **58% or a CGPA of 5.8 out of 10**. Pick India in the "Qualifications from outside the UK" box on the course page to see the table for yourself.

The English requirement is **IELTS 6.5** overall for all three courses. The MSc courses need at least **5.5** in each skill. The MBA needs at least **6.0**.

## Who it suits

- **A good fit if** you want a one-year UK master's with tuition below the £36,800 to £47,680 that Southampton, Manchester, UCL and Edinburgh charge for MSc Computer Science.
- **Think carefully if** you are applying for the MBA without three years of work experience, or for the Computer Science course with a computing degree, because that course is for students from other subjects.

## Sources

Checked on 2 November 2026: [MSc Computer Science](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5055f/), [MSc Data Science](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5543f/), [MBA](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5823f/), [Newcastle for India](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/international/country/india/), and the gov.uk pages for [Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa) and [Money you need](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/money). Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does a master's at Newcastle University cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition for overseas students for 2027-28 is £33,400 for MSc Computer Science, £32,800 for MSc Data Science and £34,400 for the MBA. Each course lasts 12 months.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need for Newcastle University?
faq_json.a: You need IELTS 6.5 overall for all three courses. The MSc courses need at least 5.5 in each skill and the MBA needs at least 6.0.

faq_json.q: What percentage do I need from India to get into Newcastle?
faq_json.a: Newcastle's grade table says a UK 2:1 equals 60% or a CGPA of 6.0 out of 10, and a 2:2 equals 58% or a CGPA of 5.8 out of 10.

faq_json.q: Do I need work experience for the Newcastle MBA?
faq_json.a: Yes. The MBA course page asks for at least three years of work experience.
